<p>        A large analysis of more than 170,000 reasoning traces from open-source reasoning models shows that large language models rely heavily on simple, default strategies when tasks get harder. A new cognitive science framework for categorizing thinking processes makes it easier to see which abilities are missing and when extra reasoning guidance in the prompt actually helps.</p>
